description: Make a new Instagram post, carousel, story or reel for a profile from an idea: SmartGenius plans it, writes every slide in the profile's voice, draws the images and writes the caption and hashtags. A reel (`format: reel`) is made of scenes, each with its narration: `seconds` is its limit, 30 or 60, and `slides` its scenes. This call makes the scenes, their narration and the caption. Its video is made only in the studio, at `studioUrl`, after a person confirms the narration there, and uses 1 more credit per started 30 seconds. No idea yet? Leave `idea` out and set `research: true`: SmartGenius picks the subject itself, the way Autopilot does, from the profile's saved ideas and what its daily research found in its niche, with that research's sourced facts. Without an idea and without `research: true` the call is refused. It answers at once, while the post is still being made. Call get_post with `wait` until `making.status` is `done` (a carousel takes a few minutes). Calling this again makes a second post and spends credits again, unless you send the same `requestId`: then you get the first post back. Costs one credit per newly generated image, caption included, not a fixed post fee. Text-only slides cost no credits. The post lands as a DRAFT in the studio: a person approves and publishes it there (`studioUrl`). `destination` says which Instagram account it is for; read it back with the `profile` this answer gives.

cta.description: What the reader should do next

idea.description: What the post is about, in a sentence or a paragraph. Leave it out only with `research: true`

instagram.description: The id of the brand's Instagram account it is for, from list_brands. Needed only when the brand has more than one

links.description: Pages to read before planning (up to 5): an article, a product page

profile.description: A profile's handle from list_profiles, or its permanent UUID

requestId.description: Any id you make up for this call, like a UUID. Send the same one if you retry after a timeout or a lost answer: you get the first answer back and nothing is spent twice. Remembered for 24 hours

research.description: With no `idea`: let SmartGenius pick the subject from the profile's saved ideas and its daily research. With an idea, the post is about your idea

seconds.description: Reel only: the video's limit, 30 or 60 seconds. Default 30

slides.description: A carousel's slides (default 5) or a reel's scenes (default 5 for 30 seconds, 10 for 60). A post or a story has one

name: create_post
title: Create a post
